crawl_trigger.description: Example use-case: trigger a new Screaming Frog crawl on the project's primary domain with an optional .seospiderconfig override. The orchestrator captures the returned crawl_id and proceeds to crawl_progress_poll.
crawl_trigger.note: Example/scaffold instance. Phase 3 sf-crawl-orchestrator skill ships the production registry covering all 6 use-cases. This file proves the schema accepts a minimal valid instance + serves as a copy-paste starting point for new use-case authoring.
